findings.title: Unit tier red: installed norn-review copy no longer matches the bundled source
findings.detail:
Verified by running `bun test packages/cli/test/unit/assets.test.ts`: 148 pass, 1 fail — 'skills > norn-review traces every Behaviour item and criterion to a test, and writes the table into the handoff (gh-169)' fails at line 357, `expect(readFileSync(.agents/skills/norn-review/SKILL.md)).toBe(text)`. Commit 88dc8b219 restored the old copy deliberately (the release refreshes it, avoiding SK1 drift in this unit), but left the assertion that pins the copy to the source. AGENTS.md: the unit tier must pass before handing back and before every commit.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Remove the installed-copy assertion at line 356-357 (the release skill refreshes .agents/skills copies, and doctor/drift covers mismatch), or relax it to something that holds between releases; keep .agents/skills/norn-review/SKILL.md as 88dc8b219 left it. Verify with `bun run test`.

findings.title: REVIEW_FILE inserted between the IGNORED doc comment and IGNORED
findings.detail:
Lines 28-32: `/** Paths that must never be committed … */` is followed by `/** gh-226: the repo's review guide … */ const REVIEW_FILE = "REVIEW.md";` and only then `const IGNORED = [...]`. The IGNORED doc comment now attaches to nothing (or reads as REVIEW_FILE's), which misleads a reader and editor hovers.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Move the REVIEW_FILE declaration and its comment above line 28 (or below IGNORED).
